study_identification.title: Dissecting the Heterogeneous Cortical Anatomy of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using Normative Models

deviation_metric.answer: Vertex-wise subject-specific Z-scores (Normative Probability Maps), FDR-corrected per subject at p<.05; regional extreme deviation = trimmed mean of top 1% absolute deviations per Desikan–Killiany region.
deviation_metric.reason: Methods detail Z-score computation, intra-individual FDR thresholding, and regional extreme deviation metric.
deviation_metric.supporting_text: subject-specific Z score... thresholded the NPMs... controlling FDR at p < .05 within each participant... regional extreme deviation was computed as the trimmed mean of the 1% of top absolute deviations... Desikan-Killiany atlas

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Spearman correlations between global and regional extreme deviations and ADOS-2/ADI-R symptom severity (p<.05, FDR). Standard vertex-wise GLM (age covariate) for group differences; explored quadratic/cubic age terms; separate male/female models for comparisons.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Few group-level case–control CT differences, but ASD shows highly individualized, widespread deviations; deviations correlate with symptom severity, with repetitive behaviors surviving multiple-comparison correction.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Under cross-validation the normative model fit TD well (few deviations). Overlap maps showed individualized ASD deviation patterns with minimal subject overlap. The 15 subjects with the most atypical anatomy were all ASD. Regional deviations, especially in prefrontal regions, correlated with repetitive behaviors (ADOS/ADI-R), surviving FDR; other symptom associations were weaker or did not survive correction.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Cross-sectional design (needs longitudinal validation); registration to a standard adult template may bias pediatric estimates; potential confounds (image quality, comorbidities, IQ) limit causal inference; no manual surface edits performed.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Individual-level FDR thresholding of NPMs; 10-fold CV on TD then retraining for ASD application; regional extreme deviation metric (top 1% trimmed mean) using Desikan–Killiany; sensitivity model including site, IQ, and Euler number dummies; male/female stratified summaries for comparisons.
